text: dhammaṃ 2 duve paṭipadāpi ca asappurisena 3 deva vuttā kumbho samādhi vedanuttiyenāti . _____________ #1 ma. yu. ayaṃ . 2 yu. ayaṃ pāṭho natthi . 3 ma. asappurisena deva kumbho . #yu. deva sappurisena kumbho . paṭipattivaggo catuttho [89] sāvatthīnidānaṃ . micchāpaṭipattiñca vo bhikkhave desessāmi sammāpaṭipattiñca taṃ suṇātha . [90] katamā
